import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

Widget buildVisibleCopy() => const Text('Save changes');

Widget buildRawCopy() => const Text(r'Raw hardcoded copy');

Widget buildTripleQuotedCopy() => const Text('''Triple hardcoded
copy''');

Widget buildRawTripleQuotedCopy() => const Text(r"""Raw triple hardcoded
copy""");

Widget buildMultilineArgument() => const Text(
  'Delete',
);

Widget buildAdjacentCopy() => const Text(
  'Save '
  'everything',
);

Widget buildMixedCopy(AppLocalizations l10n, String reason) {
  final localized = l10n.save;
  return Column(
    children: [
      Text('Still hardcoded'),
      Text('Failure: $reason'),
      Text(reason.isEmpty ? l10n.cancel : 'Delete everything'),
    ],
  );
}

Widget buildLocalizedSibling(AppLocalizations l10n) => ErrorCard(
  fileName: 'Grammar',
  message: l10n.errorLoadingGrammar('parser failure'),
);
